verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a cloud payments service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents choosing a storage region. 'Locations and zones' refers to the physical sites where readers are deployed, and offline local storage is a temporary buffer that forwards payments to Stripe, so neither is a residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
